mechanics.name: Colour Riot
mechanics.description: Tankbuster on closest and furthest target.  Paints targets hit with a colour.  Tanks alternate colours throughout the fight
steps: Party South on edge of bosses hitbox
mechanics.warning: Remember to check your colour whenever you need to take a tank buster

mechanics.name: wingmark
mechanics.description: All players will get wings, these will launch you forward in the direction you are facing.  This will be resolved later.

mechanics.name: Double Style
mechanics.description: 2 of 4 pictures will spawn.  Bomb, Succubus, Morbol, or Winged Bomb.

substeps: Move near bombs and then near succubus
2x Morbol: Move opposite the two morbols.  If they are North and West, then start South East
Bomb + Morbol: Move opposite the two morbols.  If they are North and West, then start South East.  Jump Northwest with wings
Winged Bomb + Succubus: Move to bomb side, then away from morbol.  If bombs are west, and morbol North, start SE.  Jump NW with wings
Light Parties: G1 Left, G2 Right.  Looking at the boss

steps.text: Spread into clockspots around boss after Colour Clash resolves
